title: Welcome to SCSFix
paragraphs: SCSFix is free and open source. Everything it does on your PC is free, with no account needed.
SCSFix is a fork of SCSKiller. The community shader hash database and the Patreon sign-in are SCSKiller's service, paid for by its author's Patreon supporters: sign in only if you support SCSKiller.
SCSFix sends nothing on its own: no usage ping, and it doesn't update itself. Download a new release to update.
share: Help improve the community shader hash database (shared anonymously with SCSKiller)
